_note: 13 白名單端點(base-web 實際呼叫的)。method 為人工修正後真實值(WebFetch 原始 method 欄不可靠)。型別標註重點:id/parentId/pId=integer(number)、userId=string — 對齊設計書 ⚠️r 逐欄位忠實 typings。response schema 多為通用信封 {data,code,msg};data 具體形以此為準、實測 body 見 base-web-capture.json。
_scope_excluded: react路由/debug×2/用户列表(废弃)/用户配置×2/getMenuList(舊版非v2)/281003433+ 範本 25 個 — base-web 不用、不收。alova-only(sendCaptcha/verifyCaptcha/addUser/updateUser/getLastTime) apifox 文件未定義。

/auth/login.req: Header: apifoxToken?(string, 例 XL299...). Body application/json: {userName:string 必需, password:string 必需}. 例 {"userName":"Soybean","password":"123456"}
/auth/login.resp200: {data:object 必需, code:string 必需(后端请求状态编码), msg:string 必需(请求消息)}. 例 {"data":{},"code":"string","msg":"string"}

/auth/getUserInfo.resp200: {userId:string 必需(用户id), userName:string 必需, roles:string[] 必需(角色类型), buttons:string[] 必需(按钮码)}. 注:apifox 把此直接寫成 data 內容形;base-web 實測外層仍是 {data:{...,code,msg}} 信封

/auth/refreshToken.req: Body application/json: {refreshToken:string 必需(用于获取新token)}
/auth/refreshToken.resp200: {data:object 必需, code:string 必需, msg:string 必需}. 例 {"data":{},"code":"0000","msg":"请求成功"}

/auth/error.req: Query: {code?:string(错误编码), msg?:string(错误信息)}
/auth/error.resp200: {data:null, code:string 必需, msg:string 必需}

/route/getUserRoutes.resp200: {data:{routes:MenuRoute[], home:string}, code, msg}. MenuRoute={name:string, path:string, component:string, meta:Meta, children:MenuRoute[]}. Meta={title:string, i18nKey:string, order:number, keepAlive:bool, constant:bool, icon:string, localIcon:string, href:string, hideInMenu:bool, activeMenu:string, multiTab:bool, fixedIndexInTab:number, query:[{key:string,value:string}], buttons:[{desc:string,code:string}]}. Meta 必需欄:title/constant/query/buttons

/route/getConstantRoutes.resp200: {data:MenuRoute[], code, msg}. 同 getUserRoutes 的 route/meta 形,但 data 直接是陣列(非 {routes,home})

/systemManage/getRoleList.req: Query: {current:string 必需(页码,例1), size:string 必需(每页数量,例10), roleName?:string, roleCode?:string, status?:string}
/systemManage/getRoleList.resp200: {data:{records:[{id:integer, createBy:string?, createTime:string?, updateBy:string?, updateTime:string?, status:string, roleName:string 必需, roleCode:string 必需, roleDesc:string?}], current:number, size:number, total:number}, code, msg}

/systemManage/getUserList.req: Query: {current:string 必需, size:string 必需, userName?:string, userGender?:string, nickName?:string, userPhone?:string, userEmail?:string, status?:string}
/systemManage/getUserList.resp200: {data:{records:[{id:integer, createBy, createTime, updateBy, updateTime, status:string, userName:string, userGender:string, nickName:string, userPhone:string, userEmail:string, userRoles:string[]}], current:number, size:number, total:number}, code, msg}

/systemManage/getAllRoles.resp200: {data:[{roleName:string 必需, roleCode:string 必需}], code, msg}. 扁平清單、無分頁(下拉選單用)

/systemManage/getMenuList/v2.resp200: {data:{records:[{id:integer, createBy, createTime, updateBy, updateTime, status:string, parentId:integer, menuType:string, menuName:string, routeName:string, routePath:string, component:string, order:number, i18nKey:string, icon:string, iconType:string, hideInMenu:bool, multiTab:bool, fixedIndexInTab:number, keepAlive:bool, constant:bool, href:string, buttons:[{code:string,desc:string}], query:[{key:string,value:string}], children:[]}]}, code, msg}. ★ 注意:無外層 current/size/total 分頁包(與 getUserList/getRoleList 不同;對齊設計書 §7.1 getMenuList/v2 僅分頁無 filter 之說、實為樹狀全量)

/systemManage/getAllPages.resp200: {data:string[], code, msg}. 頁面 component 名清單

/systemManage/getMenuTree.resp200: {data:[{id:integer, label:string 必需, pId:integer, children:[]}], code, msg}
